title: Alper Jewish Community Center - Theater
address:
11155 SW 112th Ave
Miami, Florida 33176

description:
The Alper Jewish Community Center in Miami includes a comprehensive fitness center with a state-of-the-art gym and an outdoor pool, alongside the theater this project renovated.

Theater updates included deep cleaning of the auditorium seating and carpets and a redesigned, more accessible concession stand. The space continues to host community arts programs, youth performing arts groups, and live stage productions.
